entries.reason: The shared corpus host now supports an explicit non-zero user-field session and covers four-slot integer round trips on a body alone and independently on a body plus face. Zero-length, multi-slot boundary and callback/error classes remain separate cases.

evidence.runtime: A four-slot session accepts PK_ENTITY_set_user_field and survives text transmit/receive; a fresh default zero-slot session returns PK_ERROR_no_user_fields (949).

entries.recheckWhen: Add zero-length, boundary-size and callback/error cases and verify their receive semantics under fresh sessions.

entries.reason: The current checked-in runtime rejects the smallest implicit TPMS lattice construction with PK_ERROR_lattice_geometry (5277), before a lattice can be embedded in a region or transmitted as a part.
entries.recheckWhen: Obtain a runtime/license with lattice geometry enabled or a documented seed lattice, then repeat create, region embed, ask and x_t self-receive.

entries.reason: The frozen corpus host intentionally uses text transmit and does not register an indexed frustrum or pass an indexed context. A direct runtime probe of PK_PART_transmit_b with indexio format and no registered callbacks returned PK_ERROR_not_implemented (5000), so no indexed-context x_t is claimed.
entries.recheckWhen: Add a dedicated indexed-I/O host contract that registers all PK_SESSION_indexio_t callbacks and supplies a context, then verify deterministic transmit/receive and key/index semantics.

notes: Facet-body conversion is the only mesh-related producer currently proven to create a persistent body and pass host self-receive checks.

The named real, string, vector, integer and axis Attribute cases prove PK_ATTDEF_create_2 field naming and named setter/ask payload semantics; named Unicode-string and pointer fields remain separate coverage.
MESH_create_from_facets was not promoted to a case because the callback ABI probe was not stable; no hand-written mesh x_t is used as evidence.
Unreachable entries are not counted as covered and must be re-audited when host/runtime capabilities change.
recheckWhen: PKToy binding, Parasolid header, schema, runtime or license changes.
The shared corpus host gains session user-field, embedded mesh, lattice and indexed-I/O options.
